title: C2 Milestone 1: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has superado el primer hito del nivel C2. Ya no estás aprendiendo inglés; estás aprendiendo a usar el inglés como un instrumento de poder, persuasión y precisión. ¡La maestría está a tu alcance!

parts.visual:
En este primer hito de C2 evaluaremos tu maestría en las lecciones 1 a 4: 

1. Advanced Phrasal Verbs: Take in (engañar/asimilar), Put down (humillar/anotar), Make out (distinguir/fingir), Pull off (lograr). 
2. Subtle Modals: Needn't have vs Didn't need to (esfuerzo en vano vs no necesario), Might as well (bien podríamos), Dare, Should (si por si acaso).
parts.audio: In this first C2 milestone, we will evaluate your mastery of lessons 1 to 4. We will test Advanced Phrasal Verbs with multiple meanings, such as Take in, Put down, Make out, and Pull off. We will also review Subtle Modals, like Needn't have versus Didn't need to, Might as well, Dare, and the conditional use of Should.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos Vocabulario Corporativo y Legal: 

3. Corporate Strategy: Move the goalposts, weather the storm, stalemate, find middle ground, the elephant in the room. 
4. Legal English: Indemnification, severability, force majeure, breach of contract, binding, null and void. 

¡Demuestra que puedes comunicarte en los niveles más altos de cualquier organización!
parts.audio: We will also review Corporate and Legal Vocabulary. From Corporate Strategy: idioms like Move the goalposts, weather the storm, stalemate, find middle ground, and the elephant in the room. From Legal English: terms like Indemnification, severability, force majeure, breach of contract, binding, and null and void. Show that you can communicate at the highest levels of any organization!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio C2 en este examen integral.

questions.question: I cooked a huge dinner, but nobody was hungry. I ____ all that food.
questions.explanation: Lo hizo en vano -> Needn't have cooked.

questions.question: It was so foggy that the pilot couldn't ____ the runway. (Distinguir visualmente).
Changing the requirements two days before the deadline is completely unfair. You can't just ____ the goalposts!
questions.explanation: Move the goalposts = cambiar las reglas injustamente.

questions.question: If you violate this NDA, you will be liable for a material ____ of contract.
I didn't think we could secure the account, but the sales team managed to pull it ____ at the last second.
Since both flights are delayed and we're stuck in the lounge, we ____ get a drink.
We were completely taken ____ by the fake investment scheme. We lost thousands.
The negotiations are currently in a ____. Neither side is willing to compromise.
Due to the tsunami, the shipping company invoked the ____ clause.
____ you have any questions, please contact our legal department. (Si de casualidad).
questions.explanation: Should you have = If you should have.

questions.question: The ____ clause ensures that if one part of the contract is illegal, the rest remains valid.
It's an ____ battle trying to convince the board to invest in such a risky venture. (Cuesta arriba).
The constant bullying at the office really puts her ____. (Humillar/Criticar).
We must ____ the storm until the economy recovers.
questions.explanation: Weather the storm = sobrevivir a la crisis.

questions.question: This document is a legally ____ agreement once signed by both parties.
Nobody wanted to mention the CEO's arrest; it was the ____ in the room.
How ____ you speak to the Chairman in that tone of voice!
The supplier agreed to ____ the company against any legal claims regarding the product's safety.
When he was younger, he ____ always interrupt people during meetings. (Hábito molesto en el pasado).
questions.explanation: Would (para expresar un hábito irritante en el pasado).

questions.question: We need to find middle ____ if we want to sign this partnership today.
questions.explanation: Find middle ground = llegar a un acuerdo mutuo.

questions.question: Take ____ the new information. (Asimilar)
They managed to pull it ____. (Lograrlo)
You ____ have worried! (Te preocupaste en vano)
We ____ as well leave now. (Podríamos - no hay opción mejor)
Move the ____. (Cambiar objetivos injustamente)
Weather the ____. (Sobrevivir a la crisis)
A ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento legal)
Force ____. (Fuerza mayor)
Legally ____. (Vinculante con B)
Null and ____. (Nulo con V)

pairs.target: Cambiar las reglas a mitad de juego
Llegar a un punto de acuerdo
